scenes.title: Key ideas
items: Caps are percentages, so position sizes rise, and so does market impact.
Add independent protocols and issuers before adding size to existing ones.
More size means more value at stake in custody
scenes.vo: Compounding: reinvesting the retained share grows principal, and income with it. At a 4.66% risk-adjusted yield with 30% retained, principal grows about 1.4% a year from retention alone. The payout grows at about the same rate: $16,310 to about $17,480 after five years (before any new capital). Scaling rules as the book grows: Check pool depth and exit liquidity at the new size. Annual review (one page): Caps are percentages, so position sizes rise, and so does market impact. Add independent protocols and issuers before adding size to existing ones. More size means more value at stake in custody: revisit Module 12.2. Balance sheet: start versus end equity, L.T.V., runway Income: expected versus realised, by source
